All new AK- and AU- codes are provisional, minted with code_rule using the key 'mind-health:<kind>:<slug>' and checked against every code in the repo at the time of writing. Existing ids in coverage carry their code; Maya Vaughn ids are her workbook slugs from supabase/seed/seed.sql.
